blindSummary: Went furthest on non-cooperation: a 2023 law declares out-of-state anti-trans laws "against the public policy of this state" and blocks out-of-state warrants, arrests and extradition related to gender-affirming care — a state/province refusing to enforce other states'/provinces' hostility. In the "most protective" tier; among the safest legal environments in the country for a trans visitor. Clearly above the country-wide average.
